title: Customizations - Updates
description: V4: Updates apply directly with only a transient updating toast. Completed plugins lose their Update action and update-available metadata, then move from Needs Action into User. When no actionable updates remain, Needs Action and the Plugins/Customizations update indicators disappear. Plugin details retain the Customizations sidebar and show a linked yellow warning when a plugin disables marketplace Auto Update. Marketplace Auto Update exception controls remain available.
